name: Kitamikado Misako
source: The Headmistress of the Academy and [url=/c3106]Ayaka[/url] and [url=/c3105]Ritsuko's[/url] mother. She is a traditionalist who [spoiler]has a strong dislike for anything and anyone that defiles her memories of her time as a Vincennes student, and [/spoiler]attempts to water down the plan to bring [url=/c3103]Masaya[/url] into Vincennes, as well as attempting to have him driven out.
